verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is driven entirely through REST APIs (POST /acp/v1/tokens, /instructions, /instructions/{id}/credentials) with a separate test host, a self-serve sandbox for test transactions, and an npm-published MCP server, so it can be scripted programmatically without a UI. However, the core flows deliberately require human steps (passkey authentication of Payment Instructions, OTP/step-up identity verification on card enrollment), which limits fully unattended automation, and nothing documents CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless automation guidance, a non-interactive path for passkey/step-up in sandbox testing, independent hands-on corroboration of automated runs.
